shared_elements: low-relief carved motifs on a flat rectangular surface
small repeated schematic signs/shapes arranged in rows
justification: Both surfaces bear schematic low-relief motifs, and both include at least one register-like horizontal row of small repeated shapes, but that is a generic correspondence any carving tradition could produce. A is an all-over dense field of tiny uniform sign-like marks with no dominant figures, whereas B is dominated by a few large distinct creatures in profile (a quadruped above a smaller figure, a long-necked bird, a branching/serpentine form) placed in clear separate zones on a T-shaped support.
